category_title: Students performing as rhythmic, collaborative poetry readers
scenario_title: Rhythmic and vocal disruption during partner reading
minimal_context: Bill and Kwame are participating in a readers' workshop where they are supposed to pair up and read poetry texts to build their stamina.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for readers' workshop. Please pair up and read your poems to each other to build your reading stamina.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Taking turns reading in singing voices) This is the way! Hey! We start the day! Hey!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just read the text on the page, please.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continuing in singing voices) We get the knowledge! Hey! To go to college! Hey!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep going, but remember the rule for readers' workshop is that it should be quiet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tapping their pencils on the desks and moving their bodies from side to side) We won't stop there! Hey! Go anywhere! Hey! (They start singing louder and invite the peers next to them to join their rhythm)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for readers' workshop. Please pair up and read your poems to each other to build your reading stamina.

STUDENT: (Taking turns reading in singing voices) This is the way! Hey! We start the day! Hey!

TUTOR: Let's just read the text on the page, please.

STUDENT: (Continuing in singing voices) We get the knowledge! Hey! To go to college! Hey!

TUTOR: Keep going, but remember the rule for readers' workshop is that it should be quiet.

STUDENT: (Tapping their pencils on the desks and moving their bodies from side to side) We won't stop there! Hey! Go anywhere! Hey! (They start singing louder and invite the peers next to them to join their rhythm)

task.learning_goal: Read just-right books to build their stamina

context.environment: Readers' workshop where one of the central rules was that it should be quiet
context.materials: Poems, pencils, desks, just-right books, poetic licenses, shared text
context.social_setting: Pair up to read poems to one another

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Invite their peers to read poems together, join their voices as they read the same text, and keep the rhythm of poems by tapping pencils on desks and moving their bodies from side to side

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Take turns to read the poem in singing voices
